decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already updates the FAQ sections to remove the mandatory six-ticket statement and require weighted-draw allocation of the $10 no-referral commission.
A same-message MODIFY already sets the no-referral commission to $10 and requires weighted-draw allocation among eligible NFT owners.
A same-message AMBIGUOUS Event already records that the client leaves the six-ticket requirement unresolved while accepting that a code-free purchase may lack tickets.

The landing-page copy requirement still states that a missing referral produces an $18 commission assigned to a random NFT owner, which conflicts with the new $10 weighted-draw rule for code-free purchases.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Whether or not a 'code-free purchase' generates 6 tickets could go either way, so a missing ticket on that kind of purchase may be acceptable.

The unresolved question is where the $10 commission goes on those no-referral mints. I would like those commissions to default to me, but that could encourage sympathetic buyers to omit their referral codes and discourage affiliates from participating. Because of that, the $10 commission from no-referral purchases has to be assigned by weighted draw.

value_updates.referral_reward_copy_requirement: State that only NFTs confirmed before checkout are valid referrals; an accepted referral gives the chosen referrer a $25 credit and entry into the $2,000 reward drawing. For a code-free purchase, do not require six tickets, and state that its $10 commission is assigned by weighted draw among eligible NFT owners. A rejected referral continues to assign an $18 commission and a $900 draw entry to a random NFT owner.
